北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温舒适，适合户外活动，记得带件外套。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with comfortable temperatures, great for outdoors. Remember a light jacket.

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨伴大风，路面湿滑，请带好雨具，注意出行安全哦！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and strong winds. Roads are slick, bring your umbrella, and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨伴大风，出行请带好雨具，小心路滑，注意防风哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and strong winds. Bring rain gear, watch for slippery roads, and stay safe!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 天气炎热，体感闷热，多补充水分，注意防晒防暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: It's hot and muggy! Stay hydrated, protect from sun, and prevent heatstroke!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 艳阳高照，体感炎热，注意防晒补水，避免长时间户外活动。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot! Hydrate well, use sun protection, and avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨伴大风，路面湿滑，带好雨具，注意出行安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and strong winds. Roads are slick, bring your umbrella, and stay safe!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴风大，湿度高，出门注意防风，小心高空坠物哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and very windy! Be careful of strong gusts and falling objects when outside.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 晴空万里，气温高，注意防晒补水，避免阳光直晒哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies and high temperatures. Stay hydrated, use sun protection, and avoid direct sun!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 多云炎热，风力大，注意防晒防风，外出小心高空坠物哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and hot with strong winds. Protect from sun and wind, and watch for falling objects!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 多云炎热，体感温度高，多喝水，注意防晒，避免中暑哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and hot! Stay hydrated, use sun protection, and avoid heatstroke!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆热情似火，体感超高，注意防暑降温，多喝绿豆汤哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is scorching! Stay cool, prevent heatstroke, and drink plenty of water!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 多云湿度大，气温适宜，但昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with high humidity and pleasant temperatures. Mind the day-night temperature difference.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴空万里，气温适中，出门尽情享受这美好的天气吧！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies and moderate temperatures, perfect for enjoying the beautiful weather outdoors!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴湿度大，体感舒适，记得带件薄外套，以防着凉哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Overcast with high humidity and comfortable temperatures. Bring a light jacket to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴风大，气温高，注意防晒防风，别被吹散了头发哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and windy with high temperatures. Protect from sun and wind, and mind your hair!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴闷热，湿度大，体感较高，记得多喝水，注意防暑哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and muggy with high humidity. Stay hydrated and prevent heatstroke.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 多云湿度大，体感舒适，早晚温差变化，记得添减衣物哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with high humidity and comfortable temperatures. Adjust your clothing as temperatures change.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴却很热，体感温度高，多补充水分，注意防暑降温哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Overcast but very hot! Stay hydrated, prevent heatstroke, and stay cool.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨来啦，出门记得带伞，路滑慢行，注意安全哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain! Don't forget your umbrella. Roads may be slippery, drive safe!
